exposure: Time from first injection of antenatal corticosteroids (ANS) to delivery
outcome: Composite of mortality or severe neonatal morbidity (intraventricular hemorrhage grade 3 or greater, cystic periventricular leukomalacia, surgical necrotizing enterocolitis, or stage 3 or greater retinopathy of prematurity)
Severe neonatal brain injury (intraventricular hemorrhage grade 3 or greater or cystic periventricular leukomalacia)
cohort: The cohort included 4594 singleton very preterm infants (24-31 weeks gestational age) from 11 European countries, without severe anomalies and unexposed to repeated courses of antenatal corticosteroids.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids were associated with an immediate and rapid decline in mortality, reaching a plateau with more than 50% risk reduction after an administration-to-birth interval of 18 to 36 hours, and similar patterns were seen for composite mortality/morbidity outcomes.
